drivers: Interpretation: the nearly flat headline index concealed stronger participation in smaller stocks. Banks and IT declined, while media, realty and pharma advanced. These sector moves describe market performance; they do not establish a single cause.
watch: Watch the next session’s exchange filings and the direction of crude prices. Current options open-interest changes, PCR and contract expiry were not sufficiently verified for this report.
